means: Constructed replays, one per drawn node of harddrop's SDPC Spin page: our own piece queue and key inputs, run from an empty board through the vendored Triangle engine, ending on the page's drawn board. Not a game anyone played and not corpus data.
not_eligible_because: not a game anyone played; not corpus data
one engine, no second implementation of the boards

caveat.order: The page fixes no bag-1 order and the order here is ours: IOTSZJL as gravity allows, the T into the U slot last. Later bags put the first piece of each of the page's before-pairs first. order_reading records it per bag.
caveat.hold: No demo holds. The page saves the I in its alternate fourth bag and holds the O to tuck after one third-build TSD; the demos deal the saved I last and never place it, and do not tuck.
caveat.chain: bag 1 is drawn in two J/L colourings with one after-the-TSS illustration; 2.tsd runs through bag1.jl (stick spin's bag1.pc mirrored), and the bag-3 builds through 2.tsd, the demo that ends on the after-the-TSD illustration. The stage boards bag1.lj.left and bag1.jl.left place six pieces and leave the T unplaced.
caveat.spin: Every T-spin kind and line count is the engine's verdict on the replayed inputs.
